title: AI Patch Decision Record
description: One immutable event recording the patch-ownership gate result and the human accept/discard outcome for a single patch. Summaries fold to the latest event per patch_id. The membership of discard_reason is intentionally not constrained here: organizations may add reasons by overlay, so the value is checked against the merged definition instead.

path.description: Overlay file path as applied at gate time

sha256.description: Digest of the overlay file contents

gate_result.description: Transcribed from the gate machine-side. Hand-editing this block would let a RED result be recorded as green and defeat the contradiction check.

risk_ids.description: never_cheap question ids that were answered yes

gate_json_sha256.description: Digest of the gate's JSON report, so the transcription can be re-verified

overlays.description: Overlays applied at gate time, in application order

patch_id.description: Stable key. Repeated events for the same patch_id fold to the latest recorded_at.

team.description: Aggregation unit for the monthly retrospective

recorded_at.description: When this event was written. Orders events for the latest-wins fold.

decided_on.description: Date the accept/discard was decided. Required once decided; forbidden while pending, because a pending record has no decision date.

discard_reason.description: A discard_reason leaf id from definitions/patch-decision.yaml (without the group prefix). Membership is validated against the overlay-merged definition, not by this schema.
